name: castle-hud
description: A Castlevania-style HUD above the prompt in the Claude Code desktop app. It shows how full the context is (a blood meter), your 5-hour and weekly limits (moons), how long the prompt cache stays warm (a stopwatch), what this session and the 5-hour window cost, how long the session has run, the last turn, lines changed and running subagents (bats). A pixel castle catches fire as the context fills and grows bolder with each compaction. You earn XP, levels, daily streaks and 14 achievements as you work; type /castle to see them. Everything stays on your machine.
